decisions.reason: The product shows clear customer value with quantified annual savings, and in a growing, investing firm with R&D slack this performance is comfortably above aspiration and gives little reason to withdraw it.

As a close extension of the established range that was important enough to receive its own page, it likely meets at least provisional aspirations and the firm's growth and organisational slack support continued market presence while results accumulate.

Although evidence is weaker than for Product A, it fits the firm's modular strategic direction and established capabilities, so a growing firm with slack would usually keep it on the market unless clearer underperformance appears.

This product is close to the core offer and therefore benefits from existing sales and service routines, making withdrawal less likely when the firm is expanding and has no visible sign that results fell below aspiration.
